hold_reasoning:
HOLD. Criterion 3 rules out any new entry. Cash is EUR 221.29 against a EUR 150 floor, so only about EUR 71 is free, well below the EUR 250 minimum. The book already holds 6 real positions plus SLB dust, so there is no open slot. The best new theses today are sharp-shooter-eur's flavours and fragrance names (7/10) and sharp-shooter-usd's refiners and managed care (7/10). Both would need a held position sold to fund them, and no held thesis has broken.

Held positions:
- 4GLD.DE (118.21): above goldfinger's 110 break level.
- PHAG.L (50.95 USD): above the 47.10 hard rail. Goldfinger says the drop is pressure, not a broken thesis.
- ALV.DE (426.20): flat at cost.
- BTC-EUR (74,184): above both the EUR 71.5k shelf (satoshi) and the 72,560 low (yolo-sapiens-eur). Satoshi is still a hold at 6/10. Its value is EUR 408, about EUR 8 over the EUR 400 cap. A EUR 8 trim would be a taxable EUR cash-out paying 0.40% for a rounding-error breach, so I tolerate it and will trim only if it reaches about EUR 450. Any de-risking goes to USDC, not EUR.
- AIR.PA (190.22 vs 206.15 avg, -7.7%): no analyst has flipped to exit and no stop has printed. December loss harvesting is the planned exit if it stays under water.

NVDA is my one Nasdaq risk: 221.30 USD against a 219.21 avg, with yolo-sapiens-usd at 7/10 that the Nasdaq rollover is confirmed. Two consequences:
1. A QQQS.L hedge sized at 1/3 of the EUR 264 NVDA exposure is about EUR 88. That is below the EUR 250 minimum, so by mandate it is not placed and not rounded up.
2. I flag yolo-sapiens-usd's NVDA break line of 219.64 USD. A close below our ~219 cost basis while QQQ stays under 743 would count as a held thesis breaking, and I would review an NVDA exit next session.

The SLB residual (0.0034 shares, EUR 0.15) is dust. Closing it would cost the EUR 1.25 IBIE floor, about 8x its value, plus a weekly trade slot, so it stays until it can be closed alongside a real SLB order.

No price discrepancies: the notes' levels match the verified closes (QQQ 728.95, NVDA 221.30, PHAG.L 50.95, EURUSD 1.1160). Default HOLD stands.
